description: Imports one public patent publication into the connected organisation, with a complete publication number and explicit purpose. own is the customer’s own patent or application; competitor is someone else’s, for reference. The purpose comes from the user’s intent, not from search results alone. Own-patent imports attempt family grouping, so a separate refresh is not normally needed. A repeated request returns the existing record unchanged; a different purpose or another publication of the same application can give a conflict that names the existing record. imported means the record was saved. receipt.status reports complete, partial or incomplete processing and receipt.warnings explain limits such as a missing PDF; a null receipt means the details are unavailable. A timed-out request may have saved the record; repeating it retrieves the saved outcome. A new import can cost credits (see get_credits) and is refused once credits are spent. Returning an existing record is free.

purpose.description: own for the customer’s own portfolio; competitor for someone else’s patent

name: import_patent

creditsCharged.description: Credits this request charged; 0 when the import was free or returned an existing record, even if an earlier request was charged for it
